codeReview.summary: GET /api/v1/evaluations/:id endpoint implemented correctly with all required functionality: valid ID returns 200 with task details (id, model, dataset, status, config, progress, created_at), not found returns 404 with error, invalid UUID returns 400. Repository was fixed to return ErrNotFound for proper 404 handling. 4 test cases added covering all scenarios.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker fixed the repository GetByID method to return repository.ErrNotFound instead of a custom formatted error. This is a good pattern for consistent error handling, but ErrNotFound pattern is not explicitly documented in AGENTS.md repository conventions.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: internal/repository/evaluation_repository.go line 113: changed from 'fmt.Errorf("evaluation not found: %s", id)' to 'ErrNotFound'
